title: Vela
details: Vela is an energy startup building AI agents that take on the procurement, engineering studies, and permitting work behind large-load energy projects, so developers, utilities, and data centers can move through the interconnection queue faster. Backed by a16z speedrun and Z Fellows with a $1.3M pre-seed round. I joined as a software engineering intern in June 2025 and became a Founding Engineer in September 2025. Restructured the company's internal operations and led the SOC 2 compliance effort. Designed the company's custom fonts, theme, and brand language, along with custom animated icon sets, the landing page, and the product's animations and loading states. Built the backend architecture for the product's interfaces and did extensive hands-on UX work across the app. Led projects with three other interns, taking initiative on scoping, planning, and delivery.

title: AlphaStar Academy
details: Teaching highly gifted students from the Bay Area as part of the AlphaStar-Carina Scholarship Program, a paid internship. In the first session I mentored students 1:1 through advanced Python courses for 32 weeks (2 hours/week) across the fall and spring terms, teaching the curriculum, monitoring student progress, and meeting monthly with supervisors to discuss student development. Now in session 2, I teach USACO Bronze, introducing students to competitive programming, algorithmic problem solving, and contest strategy.

title: Algoverse
details: Conducting a 3-month intensive applied research program focused on advancing real-time visual perception systems for privacy-sensitive and resource-constrained environments. Designing and implementing a high-dimensional vector database and dynamic relational graph model to enable persistent contextual memory, sophisticated temporal reasoning, and causal analysis of evolving visual scenes. Prioritized privacy and low-latency inference by optimizing visual encoding and captioning for mobile devices, achieving sub-1GB RAM usage and rapid response times. Extending the system to automatically detect, track, and articulate changes across video frames, supporting complex queries about temporal visual events and their contextual implications.

title: Mustang Math
subtext: Platform Developer for Math Tournament Tech Team
details: Working on the Mustang Math tech team for a national competition with 1800+ combined in-person participants in collaboration with the Stanford Math Tournament team. Contributed to developing and maintaining COMPOSE, a custom tournament problem-writing platform used by Mustang Math and Stanford Math Tournament. Participated in weekly team meetings, collaborated with other developers, and contributed to feature development and platform improvements.

title: Tulip Coaching
details: Ran a tutoring service for middle school students with no experience to learn Python. Developed a curriculum that introduces programming concepts through engaging projects and hands-on exercises. Currently finished a 4-week course with 5 students, focusing on fundamental foundational skills in programming and continuing in an advanced 8-week course.

title: Let's Assist
details: Created a comprehensive online volunteering platform that helps organizations and high school CSF programs manage, automatically track, and coordinate volunteering activities for students and communities. It simplifies the process for organizations to create and manage volunteer events, track student contributions, and verify hours securely using QR codes. Currently working on expansion into Tri-Valley schools and organizations.

title: Windemere Ranch Middle School Coding Club
details: Organized club meetings and facilitated communication between members and faculty advisors. Helped develop educational content to teach fellow students programming fundamentals through hands-on projects.

title: Boy Scouts of America
details: Developed leadership skills and community service experience through active participation in troop activities. Completed numerous merit badges focused on outdoor skills, citizenship, and personal development. Participated in camping trips, service projects, and leadership training sessions.
